entries.title: Ezekiel 34:1
segments:
CHAP. XXXIV. 
 
  A  charge against the shepherds of Israel, ver. 1-6.   Their dismission from their trust, ver. 7-10.   A promise, that God would take care of his flock, ver. 11-16.   Another charge against the strong of the flock, for their injuring   the weak, ver. 17-22.   A promise of the Messiah, the great and good shepherd, ver. 23-31.

entries.title: Ezekiel 34:2
segments: V. 2. The shepherds-The rulers of the people kings, magistrates, and princes; as also priests, and prophets.  Of Israel-The two tribes, and the few out of the ten that adhere to the house of David. That feed-Contrive their own ease, advantage, and honour.

entries.title: Ezekiel 34:3
segments: V. 3. Ye kill-You contrive methods, to take first the life, and next the estate of the well-fed, the rich and wealthy.  But-You take care to lead, protect, provide for, and watch over them.

entries.title: Ezekiel 34:4
segments: V. 4. The diseased-The weak and languishing.  Bound up-Oppressors in the state, or church, broke many then, but these shepherds bound them not up.

entries.title: Ezekiel 34:5
segments: V. 5. No shepherd-No vigilant, faithful shepherd. Became meat-Were made a prey of, and devoured by all their neighbours.

entries.title: Ezekiel 34:12
segments: V. 12. In the cloudy and dark day-In the time of general distress.

entries.title: Ezekiel 34:16
segments: V. 16. The fat-The powerful and rich.  I will feed-I will judge and punish them.

entries.title: Ezekiel 34:17
segments: V. 17. I judge-Between men and men, between the smaller and weaker, and the greater and stronger, as their different state requires I will do. The rams-Rulers, who also shalt be dealt with according to their behaviour.

entries.title: Ezekiel 34:18
segments: V. 18. But ye must tread down-You great ones, eat the fat, and sweet; and what you cannot eat, you waste and spoil.  The deep waters-Which are sufficient for all.

entries.title: Ezekiel 34:20
segments: V. 20. I will judge-I will vindicate the poor. The fat cattle-The rich.  The lean-The poor.

entries.title: Ezekiel 34:23
segments: V. 23. One shepherd-Christ, the great good, chief, only shepherd, that laid down his life for his sheep.  My servant David-The seed of David, the beloved one, who was typified by David, and is in other places called by his name, as
. He shall feed-Do all the office of a good and faithful shepherd, and that for ever.

entries.title: Ezekiel 34:24
segments: V. 24. My servant-Christ was in this great work his fathers servant,

entries.title: Ezekiel 34:25
segments: V. 25. A covenant-A covenant of promises, which contain, and shall bring peace, that is all good.

entries.title: Ezekiel 34:26
segments: V. 26. Them-My returned captives, The places-All the country. My hill-Jerusalem.

entries.title: Ezekiel 34:29
segments: V. 29. A plant-The Messiah.  The shame-The reproach.

entries.title: Ezekiel 34:30
segments: V. 30. Their God-By covenant, from their forefathers. Am with them-Present with them, and reconciled to them.
